title: Prediction algorithm seems to have some problems with big treatments

comments.body: I think its possible the graph isn't sensibly scaled for your insulin ratio and its hitting a top limit on the display. Can you tell me how many carbs you would normally expect to be covered by 1 unit? Is 17 units a typical dose for you? Thanks
